items.html:
Climate Justice Lab Donations & Drop-off Locations

​​

The Climate Justice Lab receives reusable clothing, household goods, furniture and other approved donated items that can be distributed to community members, reused, refurbished, repurposed, recycled or responsibly sold to support MY Project USA programs.

This work was previously operated under names including MY Deah’s and Global Gifts & Thrift. All donation collection, drop-off locations, donation bins, pickups and related store activities are now part of the Climate Justice Lab.

Donation Drop-Off & Collection Locations
Use the locations and details below to find a Climate Justice Lab donation bin or approved drop-off point. 


Large Donations & Pickups
For furniture, large quantities, special donations or pickup questions, contact MY Project USA before bringing items to a location.

Main Climate Justice Lab Location
4004 Fondorf Dr., Columbus, OH 43228​

​

12 Locations In Columbus to Drop Off Donations - Truck Pick Up Available For Large Donations

​

Thanks to all of our partners, you can now drop off your donations of new and gently used clothes, shoes, books, toys, and other small non-breakable items in a donation box near you. These locations include:

​​

COLUMBUS:

  • Ahlul Bayt Society – 2580 W. Dublin Granville Rd. Columbus, OH 43235

  • Covenant Baptist Church – 5100 Dierker Rd. Columbus, OH 43220

  • Heritage Christian Church – 7413 Maxtown Rd. Westerville, OH 43082

  • MAS Youth Center – 4615 Northtowne Blvd. Columbus, OH 43229

  • Masjid Nimrah – 4501 Refugee Rd. Columbus, OH 43232

  • Climate Justice Lab – 4004 Fondorf Dr. Columbus, OH 43228. (Business Hours Only)

  • Noor Islamic Cultural Center – 5001 Wilcox Rd. Dublin, OH 43016

  • Omar Ibn El-Khattab Masjid – 580 Riverview Dr. Columbus, OH 43202

  • The Destiny Center – 1561 Old Leonard Ave. Columbus, OH 43219

  • The First Congregational Church – 444 E. Broad St. Columbus, OH 43215

  • Turkish American Society of Ohio (TASO) – 2885 W. Dublin Granville Rd. Columbus, OH 43235

​

We are looking for more locations. If interested in helping us or if you have any other questions, please contact us at info@myprojectusa.org.

​

MY Project USA has created this warehouse/store as an inclusive community sustainability and resource initiative honoring the legacy of Deah, Yusor and Razan, serving local families while creating youth leadership, reuse and environmental-action opportunities.

 

For More Info: 614-905-0977 -  store@myprojectusa.org
